info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Payments-v4-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Payments Listing API provides stakeholders with the ability to access and view detailed information about utility billing payments. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve a list of payments associated with utility billing, facilitating reconciliation, reporting, and customer service operations. Typical use cases include financial analysis, payment tracking, and customer inquiries. By offering a straightforward way to access payment data, this API supports effective utility management and enhances user experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information about a payment made through the billing system. It provides essential data necessary for understanding payment transactions and allows for further processing or integration.

requestBody.description: This request is used to initiate a payment process, retrieving the relevant billing payment information as specified in the schema.
